# Open Weather — Biometeorological Dashboard

A high-fidelity, data-intensive dashboard monitoring atmospheric variables and their impact on human health.

## Features

- Real-time weather data: pressure, humidity, wind speed, temperature
- Migraine risk index (0–6 pts) based on pressure deltas and humidity
- Thom's Discomfort Index (FAT.) for heat stress above 10 °C
- Wind Chill Index (POLAR/WCI) for cold conditions below 10 °C
- 7-day forecast with hourly breakdown
- Historical pressure data via ERA5 (Copernicus) from Open-Meteo
- Atmospheric memory module for interday pressure delta calculations
- Frost, tropical night, and precipitation onset alerts

## Data Sources

- [Open-Meteo API](https://open-meteo.com/) — primary weather data source (ERA5 reanalysis)

## Scientific Basis

Meteoropathy research links barometric pressure changes to migraine onset. The dashboard cross-references real-time weather with physiological metrics to provide actionable risk assessments.
